method: Native Heeler app, separate XCTest UI driver, independent accessibility and screenshot observations. Before and after server reads used the named private fixture only. Device keys and host key material are omitted. Repository content, launch arguments and test prompts are synthetic. The dedicated Devin sessions use separately authorized vendor access.

fixtures.macOS: Private SSH listener with separately selected Herdr TUI and Rex entries. Catalog and SSH trust were seeded after authorizing each simulator public key.
fixtures.debian: First-trust wizard over the private SSH listener. The running Rex and named Herdr TUI were discoverable. Only Rex was enabled in the app.
fixtures.rexOnly: Separate first-trust wizard to a different Debian SSH listener with the vendor-default Rex socket and no other supported server installed. The second macOS-only fixture is a separate private login and SSH service on the same physical Mac, with the vendor-default Rex socket and no other supported backend executable in its login path.
fixtures.agents: The executable named claude is a local recording program without model access. Notification receipts use real Pi 1.5.2 and a private loopback model.
